title: Point-unit sections are compatible with terminal geometric evaluation
statement: For an embedding i:K -> Kprime of algebraically closed fields and an arbitrary condensed abelian sheaf Lambda, let a be a section of Lambda on the singleton profinite set. Suppose terminal sections y of Lambda_(Spec K) and yprime of Lambda_(Spec Kprime) restrict to the respective specified point-adjunction units of a. Then geometricFieldEvaluationComparison(f) applied to y equals terminal evaluation of inverse condensedPullbackHom(Lambda,f) applied to yprime. There are no p-adic coefficients or coefficient coordinates in this statement.

source.place: Section 4, finite-matrix refinement: presentation and geometric-fibre comparison after coefficient realization (steps 1--3)

proof.text: Apply geometric-field evaluation coherence to y, naturality of the coefficient pullback along the singleton structural map, and the assumed normalization of y.

Expand the restriction comparison and coefficient pullback, move the coefficient map through restriction by naturality, and apply the composition-unit identity to f and toSpecZ Y. Precompose with the point unit, evaluate on a, cancel the inverse test-object pullback comparison, and use comp_toSpecZ. This yields the point unit over X.

Substitute the normalization of yprime and cancel restriction along its singleton structural map, which is invertible over the algebraically closed field Kprime. The inverse restriction is presheaf restriction along the inverse structural map. Finally apply terminal evaluation of inverse alpha; functoriality and alpha followed by its inverse give the displayed inverse-comparison identity.

proof_origin.place: Sections 4 and 5: composition-unit pasting, singleton evaluation coherence, and cancellation of specified comparisons

theorem terminal_transport (K K' : Type u) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K]
    [Field K'] [IsAlgClosed K'] (i : K →+* K')
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    (a : Λ.obj.obj (op (Profinite.of (ULift.{u, 0} PUnit.{1}))))
    (y : (condensedRingObj Λ (Spec (.of K))).obj.obj
      (op (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of K))))))
    (hy : (((geometricFieldAbelianPointAdjunction (Spec (.of K))).unit.app Λ).hom.app
        (op (Profinite.of (ULift.{u, 0} PUnit.{1})))).hom a =
      ((condensedRingObj Λ (Spec (.of K))).obj.map
        (geometricFieldTestFinalMap (Spec (.of K))).op).hom y)
    (y' : (condensedRingObj Λ (Spec (.of K'))).obj.obj
      (op (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of K'))))))
    (hy' : (((geometricFieldAbelianPointAdjunction (Spec (.of K'))).unit.app Λ).hom.app
        (op (Profinite.of (ULift.{u, 0} PUnit.{1})))).hom a =
      ((condensedRingObj Λ (Spec (.of K'))).obj.map
        (geometricFieldTestFinalMap (Spec (.of K'))).op).hom y') :
    let f := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom i)
    let E' := sheafToPresheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (Spec (.of K'))) Ab.{u + 1} ⋙
      (evaluation _ _).obj (op (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of K')))))
    ((geometricFieldEvaluationComparison f Ab).app
      (condensedRingObj Λ (Spec (.of K)))).hom y =
    (E'.map (inv (condensedPullbackHom Λ f))).hom y'
